materials.noteSuffix: . Quantities allow up to 3 decimal places; unit prices are whole VND. Each line is rounded to the dong, then the system sums the total.

schedule.conflict: This form holds outdated content. Close it and reopen the schedule from the list to edit the latest data.
schedule.note: Schedules track due dates. The system does not put UAVs into maintenance or send reminders automatically. The next cycle is counted from the completion date of the linked order, in Vietnam time.

orderCreate.title: Create repair order
orderCreate.note: Each UAV can have only one unclosed order. Creating an order for planning does not change the UAV status; the system checks missions holding the UAV only when the repair starts.

order.mustInspect: Confirm the UAV has been inspected before completing.

desc.start: Start only when the UAV no longer belongs to an active mission. The UAV will move to maintenance and cannot take missions.
desc.complete: The technician's confirmation is recorded on the order; it is not a technical certification. The UAV will become available and the linked schedule is recalculated from today.
desc.cancelStarted: The order has started: after cancelling, the UAV stays in maintenance. Recorded material costs are kept. Create a new order or inspect the UAV before returning it to service.
desc.cancelOpen: Cancelling an order that has not started does not change the UAV status. Recorded costs are kept and the schedule due date is unchanged.

order.inspectedConfirm: I confirm the UAV has been inspected and may return to service.
order.title: Repair order #{id}
order.materialsNote: Material costs are recorded on the order and do not deduct equipment inventory. The system calculates the total from saved lines.
order.closedNote: The order is closed. Its information and costs are kept for reference and cannot be edited.

success.materials: Materials saved. The total cost has been recalculated.
success.start: Repair started. The UAV is under maintenance.
success.complete: Order completed and the UAV is available again.
success.cancel: Order cancelled. Recorded costs are kept.
